title: Typography
slide_intent: Announce the shift from palette to type and let the heading act as a specimen. The reader encounters the section’s subject in the form of its title.
strategic_value: A familiar cover rhythm can connect the typographic rules to the rest of Bolt’s identity book.
demonstration: The large word Typography appears in the same position and contrast used on the earlier chapter dividers.
practical_value: Use the title page to introduce the two typefaces before presenting their roles, color pairings and emphasis rules.

content_islands.name: Book identifiers
content_islands.spec: Place a small white Bolt mark in the upper-left corner and the folio in the lower-left corner.

content_islands.name: Section title
content_islands.spec: Set “Typography” in large white type on the dark full-page field. Align the title near mid-height, inset farther than the small identifiers.
